meta.name: game-ux-designer
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about game UI, onboarding, HUD design, controller navigation, player feedback, usability testing, colorblind modes, or game-specific UX patterns. Triggers on: "UI", "UX", "onboarding", "HUD", "controller nav", "usability", "colorblind", "player feedback", "menu design". Do NOT invoke for deep accessibility audits (use game-accessibility-specialist) or art style (use game-art-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化游戏界面与玩家交互体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计游戏界面或玩家交互流程
copy.tagline_en: Optimize game interfaces and player interaction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing game interfaces or player interaction flows

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会化身为游戏 UX 设计师，帮你设计游戏界面、新手引导、HUD、控制器导航、玩家反馈、可用性测试、色盲模式等，确保所有玩家都能理解、导航并享受游戏。
howto.when: 当你询问游戏 UI、UX、新手引导、HUD、控制器导航、可用性、色盲模式、玩家反馈或菜单设计时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个色盲友好的 HUD。
say.note: Claude 会提供色盲模式的具体设计建议。

say.text: 如何设计一个渐进式的新手引导？
say.note: Claude 会解释渐进式披露原则并给出示例。

say.text: 我的游戏需要可重映射的控制选项。
say.note: Claude 会提供可重映射控制的实现建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes a game UX designer who helps design game UI, onboarding, HUD, controller navigation, player feedback, usability testing, colorblind modes, etc., ensuring every player can understand, navigate, and enjoy the game.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about game UI, UX, onboarding, HUD, controller navigation, usability, colorblind modes, player feedback, or menu design.

say_en.text: Design a colorblind-friendly HUD for my game.
say_en.note: Claude will provide specific design suggestions for colorblind modes.

say_en.text: How to design a progressive onboarding flow?
say_en.note: Claude will explain progressive disclosure principles and give examples.

say_en.text: I need remappable controls in my game.
say_en.note: Claude will provide implementation advice for remappable controls.
